About the watermark on these documents

All certificates and award documents on this page are shown at limited resolution with the official PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri watermark, to prevent misuse by unauthorised parties. Original copies without the watermark are provided only on formal request to tcm@trimitraciptamandiri.com.
